ontario: The most populous province; home to Toronto and Ottawa
quebec: French-speaking province with a walled capital and Montreal
nova-scotia: Maritime province on a peninsula; capital Halifax
new-brunswick: The only officially bilingual province; capital Fredericton
manitoba: Prairie province with Winnipeg and polar bears in Churchill
british-columbia: Pacific province with Vancouver; capital Victoria
prince-edward-island: The smallest province, an island famous for Anne of Green Gables
alberta: Oil-rich province with Banff and the Calgary Stampede
newfoundland-and-labrador: Easternmost province, an island plus mainland; capital St. John's
northwest-territories: Northern territory with Great Slave Lake; capital Yellowknife
yukon: Territory of the Klondike Gold Rush; capital Whitehorse
nunavut: The newest and largest territory, mostly Inuit; capital Iqaluit
